name: @stewardmd/capacitor-ecg-digitiser
description: On-device ECG image digitiser. iOS runs the nnU-Net ECG-Digitiser via Core ML (built into iOS, Neural Engine); Android via ONNX Runtime. The photo never leaves the device — only the per-pixel lead segmentation label map is returned. Model downloaded on first use.
author: StewardMD
_note: iOS-only for now (Core ML, zero third-party runtime). Android (ONNX Runtime AAR) added after iOS is device-validated; then add capacitor.android.src + android/* to files.
